question: The average age of 51 students of a class is 21 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 22 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Increase in average = 22 − 21 = 1

Total people after adding teacher = 52

Extra total age added = 1 × 52 = 52

Teacher’s age = old total + increase − old total = 21 + 52 − 21

**∴ Answer = 73**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 51 students = 21 years, new average (including teacher) = 22 years

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number of persons

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of 51 students = 51 × 21 = 1071

⇒ Total age of 52 persons = 52 × 22 = 1144

⇒ Teacher’s age = 1144 − 1071

⇒ = 73

**∴ The correct answer is 73.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of items

Total Calculation

Total = Average × Number

Change in Average Trick

Increase in total = Change in average × New number of persons

Quick Insight

Difference in totals directly gives the new added value
